simple.meaning: שָׁשָׁה (shâshâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to sixth or divide into sixths.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 45:13. The surrounding contexts include offering.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁשָׁה (H8341) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁשָׁה (shâshâh) / H8341 is traced through Ezekiel 45:13 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to sixth or divide into sixths
definitions.full: H8341. shishshah [ שִׁשָּׁה ] verb Pi`el denominative give sixth part of (si vera lectio); — Perfect 2masculine plural consecutive הָאֵיפָה וְשִׁשִּׁיתֶם Ezek 45:13 (+ מִן particle), but < read שִׁשִּׁית Vrss and modern (|| שִׁשִּׁית v a ). — וְשִׁשֵּׁאתִיךָ 39:2 see שׁשׁא .
